items.headline: Samuel out at least a couple of weeks
items.summary: Kyle Shanahan says Samuel strained his hamstring "pretty good" against Seattle and will miss at least a couple of weeks. Christian Kirk is unlikely to practice this week either, so San Francisco is very thin at receiver against Washington.

items.headline: Wilson ruled out vs. Buccaneers
items.summary: Mike McCarthy said Wilson (finger) will not play Sunday at Tampa Bay, and ESPN reports he could miss multiple weeks. Pittsburgh is short of receivers.

items.headline: Skowronek out vs. Buccaneers
items.summary: McCarthy said Skowronek (calf) will not play Sunday. With Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. out, the Steelers' passing targets concentrate on the remaining receivers and tight ends.

items.headline: Charbonnet stays out for Thursday night
items.summary: Mike Macdonald said Charbonnet (knee) will not be activated from reserve for Thursday against Denver, even though he was listed as limited on the practice estimate. George Holani keeps the lead role.

items.headline: Jackson improving, real chance to play at Cleveland
items.summary: Jesse Minter says Jackson (ankle) is "definitely doing better," and ESPN earlier reported a real chance he plays Sunday. Tyler Huntley beat Atlanta in overtime and starts if Jackson sits. Status is unknown until the week's injury reports.

items.headline: Bears undecided on quarterback at Atlanta
items.summary: Ben Johnson has not said whether Williams (hamstring), Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum will start Sunday. Williams is "close," so Chicago's passing projection depends on who is announced.

items.headline: Barkley and Smith hopeful to return vs. Panthers
items.summary: Nick Sirianni says he is hopeful that both Barkley and DeVonta Smith (hamstrings) return Sunday. Will Shipley is out for multiple weeks, so Philadelphia's backfield depends on Barkley's status.

items.headline: Harrison joins Houston ahead of London game
items.summary: The Texans completed a trade for Harrison. How much he plays against Jacksonville after a week with the team is unknown, and David Montgomery is week-to-week.

items.headline: Penix expected to be available vs. Bears
items.summary: ESPN reports Penix's rib injury is not considered serious after he left the loss to Baltimore. Tua Tagovailoa played in relief, so he is the backup if Penix is limited.

items.headline: Shipley has a partial plantar fascia tear
items.summary: ESPN reports Shipley could be sidelined multiple weeks, which leaves Dameon Pierce as the main alternative to Barkley.

items.headline: Montgomery week-to-week with groin injury
items.summary: DeMeco Ryans called Montgomery week-to-week, so Houston's backfield share is uncertain for Sunday morning in London.

items.headline: Moore was inactive Monday with a shoulder injury
items.summary: Moore missed the overtime win over the Rams. His status for Sunday at Las Vegas is not yet known, and Joshua Palmer was also inactive.

items.headline: Harris week-to-week with hamstring injury
items.summary: Jim Harbaugh called Harris week-to-week after the loss to Denver. Ladd McConkey was active but played no snaps, and Quentin Johnston is out, so the Chargers' receivers are very thin at Kansas City.

items.headline: Rice (hamstring) could be back after the bye
items.summary: Rice's hamstring injury was described as relatively minor and Kansas City had a bye in Week 5, so he could return against the Chargers. His status has not been updated this week.

items.headline: Judkins day-to-day with ankle injury
items.summary: Todd Monken called the ankle a "tweak," and Judkins has not been ruled out for the Ravens game. Raheim Sanders (hip) is also questionable.

items.headline: Concepcion is in concussion protocol
items.summary: He left the loss to the Jets after a hit to the head. Cleveland already lost Tylan Wallace, so its receivers are thin.

items.headline: Dowdle expected back vs. Buccaneers
items.summary: Steelers offensive coordinator Brian Angelichio anticipates Dowdle (toe) returns Sunday. Jaylen Warren had 188 yards from scrimmage while he was out, so the workload could be shared.

items.headline: Mayfield's thumb status is unknown
items.summary: Mayfield's thumb was in a smaller splint last week, and ESPN still lists him as out. Tampa Bay's starter against Pittsburgh is unclear.

items.headline: Henderson has more ankle testing after Raiders game
items.summary: Henderson was set for further tests Monday after leaving the win. Rhamondre Stevenson is the other main back against the Jets.

items.headline: Hall and Mitchell still listed out
items.summary: ESPN still lists Hall and Adonai Mitchell as out after they missed the win over Cleveland. Their status at New England is unknown.

items.headline: Smith-Njigba limited with ankle injury
items.summary: Smith-Njigba was a limited participant on Monday's practice estimate ahead of Thursday night at Denver. A reduced role is possible. Drew Lock (forearm) is also limited as the backup quarterback.

items.headline: About 19 mph wind forecast for Steelers at Buccaneers
items.summary: A forecast of around 19 mph wind at Raymond James Stadium can cut deep passing and kicking. Treat it as a negative for passing yards.

items.headline: About 19 mph wind forecast for Cowboys at Packers
items.summary: A forecast of around 19 mph wind at Lambeau Field on Sunday night can cut deep passing. Treat it as a negative for passing yards.

items.headline: Coker on track to return at Philadelphia
items.summary: Dave Canales says Coker (quadriceps) is on track after missing one game.
